Overview

Philadelphia is a city in PA with a population of 1,576,000. City of Brotherly Love with the Liberty Bell, cheesesteaks, and a vibrant arts scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
